trello.name: Sign venue contract with legal review and confirm AV recording
trello.desc: Owner: Diego. Deadline: End of next week. Get the convention center contract through legal review and signed. The quote is $18,000 for the main hall plus two breakout rooms, catering separate. Confirm in writing that the AV package includes recording in all three rooms (main hall and both breakouts), since last year recording was main-hall only and breakout talks were lost. Acceptance criteria: contract signed and AV recording inclusion documented in writing for all three rooms.

trello.name: Lock the speaker lineup at nine confirmed speakers
trello.desc: Owner: Bo. Deadline: Two weeks. Currently six confirmed, need nine. Send final follow-ups to the two maybe speakers with a decision deadline of Friday. Maintain a backup list of five names; if either maybe falls through, fill the third slot from the backup list. Acceptance criteria: nine confirmed speakers locked within two weeks so the agenda can be printed.

trello.name: Obtain keynote abstract from Dr. Osei
trello.desc: Owner: Bo. Deadline: This week. Chase Dr. Osei for the keynote abstract. The abstract is needed for the website and the printed program. Acceptance criteria: keynote abstract received from Dr. Osei.

trello.name: Draft and execute three-wave email marketing campaign
trello.desc: Owner: Diego. Deadline: Draft all three waves this month. Run the email campaign in three waves: (1) agenda announcement when Bo locks the lineup, going out the day the agenda is live; (2) early-bird deadline reminder two weeks before the price change; (3) final-week push. Registration is currently at 340 against a target of 600. Acceptance criteria: all three email drafts completed this month and wave one sent the day the agenda goes live.

trello.name: Hand off speaker bios and headshots for website landing page update
trello.desc: Owner: Bo (handoff) and Diego (landing page update). Deadline: Same day the lineup locks. Once the speaker lineup locks, Bo must hand the bios and headshots straight to Diego for the landing page update on the same day, without delay. The website needs the speaker pages before email wave one. Acceptance criteria: bios and headshots handed to Diego same day lineup locks and speaker pages live on the website before wave one.

trello.name: Approve swag design proofs and place order
trello.desc: Owner: Camille (review/approve proofs today) then Diego (place order this week). Camille will review the swag design proofs located in the shared drive today. Once Camille approves, Diego places the order this week. Order details: 800 shirts across sizes, 500 notebooks, 1,000 stickers, total approximately $9,200 including rush buffer. Lead time was six weeks last year, so timing is critical. Acceptance criteria: proofs approved by Camille and order placed by Diego within this week.
